y-m-73-07.title: Shin “hauhawar farashi ta ragu a shekara ta biyu a jere” yana nufin farashi ya yi arha?
y-m-73-07.topic: Ma’aunin farashi da ƙimar hauhawar farashi
y-m-73-07.goal: Ka bambanta matakin farashi da saurin tashinsa, sannan ta amfani da lambobin teburin ka gyara kanun labari ta yadda ɗalibin ƙaramar sakandare zai fahimta.
y-m-73-07.material:
Kanun labarin jarida shi ne “Hauhawar farashi ta ragu a shekara ta biyu a jere”. Ma’aunin farashin mabukaci (2021 = 100; bayanan ƙirƙira) kamar haka. Karanta teburin bisa jere: shekara, ma’aunin farashi, ƙaruwa idan aka kwatanta da shekarar baya. An zagaye ƙimar ƙaruwa zuwa wuri ɗaya bayan ɗigo.

Shekara | Ma’aunin farashi (2021=100) | Ƙaruwa daga shekarar baya
2021 | 100.0 | -
2022 | 105.0 | 5.0%
2023 | 108.5 | 3.3%
2024 | 110.6 | 1.9%

(Ƙaruwa daga shekarar baya = yawan kashi nawa ma’aunin shekarar ya fi na shekarar baya. A ɗauka farashin sayen abu iri ɗaya ya yi daidai da ma’aunin farashi.)
y-m-73-07.thinking.1: Ware abin da teburin zai iya faɗa da abin da ba zai iya faɗa ba
y-m-73-07.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi duk abin da za a iya tabbatarwa daga teburin kaɗai.
y-m-73-07.s.s1.hint.0: Karanta ginshiƙin ma’aunin farashi daga sama zuwa ƙasa kawai, sannan ka duba ko lambobin sun ƙaru ko sun ragu.
y-m-73-07.s.s1.hint.1: Karanta ginshiƙin ƙimar ƙaruwa dabam, sannan ka faɗi ko kowace magana tana game da ma’auni ko ƙimar ƙaruwa.
y-m-73-07.s.s1.o.a: Matakin farashi a 2024 ya yi ƙasa da na 2022.
y-m-73-07.s.s1.r.a: Fihé harga naék ti 105.0 jadi 110.6. Anjeun nganggap laju kanaékanna anu beuki leutik téh sarua jeung tingkat harga anu turun.
y-m-73-07.s.s1.o.b: Tingkat harga taun 2024 leuwih luhur batan taun 2023.
y-m-73-07.s.s1.r.b: Anjeun maca yén indéks naék ti 108.5 jadi 110.6. Anjeun ngarti yén lamun laju kanaékan positif (+), tingkatna naék.
y-m-73-07.s.s1.o.c: Laju kanaékan terus beuki leutik, jadi harga bakal turun dina 2025.
y-m-73-07.s.s1.r.c: Anjeun nganggap pola tilu taun katukang pasti bakal kajadian deui taun hareup. Tabél henteu ngandung informasi ngeunaan 2025.
y-m-73-07.s.s1.o.d: Perséntase kanaékan harga unggal taun saeutik-saeutik beuki leutik.
y-m-73-07.s.s1.r.d: Anjeun maca parobahan laju kanaékan 5.0%, 3.3%, 1.9%. Ieu ngajelaskeun gedéna kanaékan, lain tingkat hargana.
y-m-73-07.s.s1.explain: Ti 2022 nepi ka 2024, indéks harga terus naék: 105.0 → 108.5 → 110.6 (b). Laju kanaékan beuki leutik: 5.0%, 3.3%, 1.9% (d). Tapi laju kanaékan anu leuwih leutik lain hartina tingkat harga turun (a salah). Tabél teu bisa méré nyaho naon anu bakal kajadian dina 2025 (c).
y-m-73-07.s.s2.prompt: Babaturan ningali artikel éta tuluy ngomong, “Harga terus turun, jadi ayeuna balanja dahareun bakal leuwih murah.” Dina 2 nepi ka 3 kalimah, jelaskeun kasalahan dina pamahaman judul ku maké hiji atawa dua angka tina tabél, supaya dulur SMP anu leuwih ngora ogé ngarti.
y-m-73-07.s.s2.hint.0: Mimitina tulis hiji kalimah anu ngabandingkeun indéks harga taun 2022 jeung 2024.
y-m-73-07.s.s2.hint.1: Jelaskeun deui “laju kanaékan beuki leutik” ku babandingan sapopoé, upamana “lajuna beuki lalaunan”.
y-m-73-07.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Naha anjeun ngabédakeun “harga (tingkat harga)” jeung “laju naékna harga”?
y-m-73-07.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Naha anjeun mariksa yén angka anu dicokot tina tabél téh bener?
y-m-73-07.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Naha anjeun nulis ku basa anu bisa dibaca ku murid SMP (ngajelaskeun istilah anu hésé)?
y-m-73-07.s.s2.model.0: Harga henteu turun; malah terus naék. Ti 105.0 dina 2022 jadi 110.6 dina 2024, hartina barang beuki mahal. Ngan gedéna kanaékan unggal taun anu beuki leutik: 5.0%, 3.3%, 1.9%.
y-m-73-07.s.s2.model.1: Artikel éta maksudna laju naékna harga beuki lalaunan. Indéks 2023 nyaéta 108.5, ari 2024 nyaéta 110.6, jadi harga sorangan tetep naék. Henteu jadi leuwih murah.
y-m-73-07.s.s2.model.2: Saperti mobil anu terus maju sanajan lajuna ngurangan, harga ogé ngan naék leuwih lalaunan; indéksna tetep naék ti 100 jadi 110.6. Jadi harga teu jadi leuwih murah, ngan naékna leuwih laun.

y-m-73-05.title: Zaɓin mutane zai iya bambanta ko da ƙimar da ake tsammani iri ɗaya ce?
y-m-73-05.goal: Ka bayyana cewa ko da ƙimar da ake tsammani iri ɗaya ce, zaɓi na iya bambanta bisa yadda mutane suke ji game da haɗarin babban asara, sannan ka ƙirƙiri sharuddan da siyan inshora zai zama ɗan riba kaɗan a ƙimar da ake tsammani.
y-m-73-05.material: Idan aka yi amfani da waya tsawon shekara ɗaya, allonta na iya karyewa. A matsayin yanayin hasashe, yiwuwar karyewa cikin shekara ɗaya ita ce 6% (a ɗauka ba za ta karye fiye da sau ɗaya a shekara ba); idan ta karye, kuɗin gyara shi ne 40万 yen. Inshorar lalacewa tana ɗaukar duk kuɗin gyara idan an biya kuɗin shekara-shekara 2万 4千 yen (kuɗin da mai inshora zai biya da kansa = 0 yen). A ɗauka an san yiwuwar daidai. (asali: 40만 원, 2만 4천 원, 0원)
y-m-73-05.thinking.0: Ƙididdige ƙimar da ake tsammani, sannan ka fassara ma’anarta.
y-m-73-05.thinking.1: Tsara sharudda ta amfani da lambobi
y-m-73-05.thinking.2: Yanke hukunci bisa ma’auni dabam da ƙimar da ake tsammani
y-m-73-05.prereq.0: Yiwuwar faruwa da ƙimar da ake tsammani (jimillar yiwuwa × ƙima)
y-m-73-05.s.s1.prompt: Idan aka kwatanta siya da rashin siyan inshora bisa “ƙimar kuɗin da aka kashe a cikin shekara”, wane kimantawa ne ya fi dacewa?
y-m-73-05.s.s1.hint.0: Rubuta duk kuɗaɗen da za a iya kashewa cikin shekara idan ba a sayi inshora ba, sannan ka rubuta yiwuwar kowane kusa da shi.
y-m-73-05.s.s1.hint.1: Nemo matsakaicin waɗannan yanayi, ka kwatanta shi da kuɗin inshora, sannan ka yi tunanin kuɗin da zai fito a zahiri idan aka dubi shekara guda kawai.
y-m-73-05.s.s1.o.a: Ƙimar da ake tsammani iri ɗaya ce, don haka duk wanda aka zaɓa, ainihin kuɗin da za a kashe a kowace shekara daidai yake.
y-m-73-05.s.s1.r.a: Ƙimar da ake tsammani matsakaici ne na lokuta da yawa. Ka rasa cewa a kowace shekara kuɗin da aka kashe a zahiri na iya zama 0円 ko 40万 円.
y-m-73-05.s.s1.o.b: 6% ƙaramar yiwuwa ce, don haka lalacewar ba za ta faru ba, kuma siyan inshora asara ce kawai.
y-m-73-05.s.s1.r.b: Ka mai da ƙaramar yiwuwa kamar “ba za ta faru ba”. Muhimmin batu shi ne, ko da yiwuwar 6% ce, idan ta faru kuɗin zai yi yawa.
y-m-73-05.s.s1.o.c: Kuɗin inshora ya yi ƙasa sosai da kuɗin gyara, saboda haka siyan inshora riba ce ko da yaushe.
y-m-73-05.s.s1.r.c: Ka kwatanta girman kuɗin inshora da na gyara kawai. Dole ne a ninka kuɗin gyara da yiwuwar buƙatar gyara domin samun kwatancen matsakaici.
y-m-73-05.s.s1.o.d: Ƙimar da ake tsammani iri ɗaya ce, saboda haka babu wanda ya fi; abin da ya bambanta zaɓin shi ne ko kana son kauce wa haɗarin babban kuɗi.
y-m-73-05.s.s1.r.d: Ka gano ma’aunin da ya rage idan ƙimar da ake tsammani iri ɗaya ce (yawan haɗarin da mutum zai iya jurewa).
y-m-73-05.s.s1.explain: Idan babu inshora, kuɗin gyara da ake tsammani shi ne 0.06 × 40万 = 2万 4천 원, daidai da kuɗin inshora. A matsakaici babu wanda ya fi, amma ba tare da inshora akwai yiwuwar 6% cewa za a kashe 40万 円 lokaci guda. Yawan son kauce wa wannan haɗari ya danganta da mutum da yanayin da yake ciki.
y-m-73-05.s.s2.prompt: A ɗauki yiwuwar lalacewa p% kuma kuɗin gyara r 만 원. Kuɗin inshorar ya kasance 2만 4천 원, sannan ka shigar da nau’i-nau’i daban-daban guda 3 na (p, r) inda kuɗin gyaran da ake tsammani ba tare da inshora ba (= r × p/100, a cikin 만 원) ya fi kuɗin inshora amma bai wuce 3만 원 ba (ribar ta yi ƙanƙanta). p cikakkiyar lamba ce daga 1 zuwa 50, kuma r cikakkiyar lamba ce daga 10 zuwa 100.
y-m-73-05.s.s2.hint.0: Zaɓi yiwuwar p guda ɗaya da kuɗin gyara r guda ɗaya, ƙididdige p × r, sannan ka kwatanta shi da 240 da 300.
y-m-73-05.s.s2.hint.1: Idan ka samo nau’i-nau’i guda ɗaya da ya cika sharadin, canza p sannan ka daidaita r domin nemo wani nau’i.
y-m-73-05.s.s2.ok.c1: p da r lambobi ne cikakku a cikin iyakar da aka kayyade.
y-m-73-05.s.s2.fail.c1: p dole ya zama cikakkiyar lamba daga 1 zuwa 50, kuma r dole ya zama cikakkiyar lamba daga 10 zuwa 100.
y-m-73-05.s.s2.ok.c2: Kuɗin gyaran da ake tsammani ya fi kuɗin inshora na 2.4万 円.
y-m-73-05.s.s2.fail.c2: Kuɗin gyaran da ake tsammani (r × p/100) dole ya fi 2.4万 円. Duba ko p × r ya fi 240.
y-m-73-05.s.s2.ok.c3: Kuɗin gyaran da ake tsammani bai wuce 3万 円 ba.
y-m-73-05.s.s2.fail.c3: Kuɗin gyaran da ake tsammani ya haura 3万 円. Rage ɗaya daga cikin lambobin domin p × r bai wuce 300 ba.
y-m-73-05.s.s2.explain: Kuɗin gyaran da ake tsammani r × p/100 dole ya fi 2.4 kuma bai wuce 3 ba, saboda haka p × r dole ya fi 240 kuma bai wuce 300 ba. Misalai: (7, 40) yana ba da 2.8万 円; (10, 30) yana ba da 3万 円; (6, 50) yana ba da 3万 円; haka nan (5, 60) yana ba da 3万 円. (6, 40) yana ba da 2.4万 円, daidai da kuɗin inshora, saboda haka bai “fi” ba.
y-m-73-05.s.s3.prompt: A yanayin s1 (ƙimomin da ake tsammani iri ɗaya ne), zaɓi ko “sayi inshorar” ko “kada a saya”, ka ɗauka akwai mutum mai yanayin da ya sa zaɓin ya dace, sannan ka rubuta dalilin tare da lambobi.
y-m-73-05.s.s3.hint.0: Rubuta kuɗin da za a kashe cikin shekara idan ta karye ba tare da inshora ba, da kuɗin idan ba ta karye ba.
y-m-73-05.s.s3.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin yadda za ka ji idan wannan 40万 円 ya zama babban kaso na kuɗin da ke asusun bankinka.

y-m-73-03.title: Labarin jarida da ya ce matsakaici ya kai 500万 円
y-m-73-03.topic: Matsakaici da tsakiyar ƙima (rarraba kuɗin shiga)
y-m-73-03.goal: Ka gane cewa ba za a iya amfani da matsakaici kaɗai domin yanke hukunci kan furucin “aƙalla rabinsu suna samun fiye da wani adadi” ba; ka faɗi irin ƙarin bayanin da ake buƙata, sannan ka ƙirƙiri bayananka waɗanda suke da matsakaici iri ɗaya amma sakamakon hukunci ya bambanta.
y-m-73-03.material: Akwai gidaje 5 a wani ƙauye. Wani labarin jarida ya ce “matsakaicin kuɗin shiga na wata na gidajen wannan ƙauye (kafin haraji, raka’a: 万 円) shi ne 500”, kuma jimlar ƙarshe ta labarin ta ce “aƙalla rabin gidajen wannan ƙauye suna samun fiye da 400万 円 a wata.” Ba a bayar da kuɗin shiga na kowane gida a labarin ba. Kuɗin shiga na kowane gida a wata aƙalla 100万 円 ne, kuma lambobi cikakku ne (a raka’ar 万 円).
y-m-73-03.thinking.1: Ƙirƙirar misalin da ke karya ƙa’ida mai matsakaici iri ɗaya amma rarrabawa dabam
y-m-73-03.prereq.0: Yadda ake nemo matsakaici da tsakiyar ƙima
y-m-73-03.s.s1.prompt: Bayan matsakaicin 500, wane bayani ne za ka buƙata domin yanke hukunci kai tsaye ko jimlar ƙarshe ta labarin gaskiya ce?
y-m-73-03.s.s1.hint.0: Ka yi tunanin jerin lambobi biyu ko uku na 5 waɗanda suke da matsakaici iri ɗaya amma siffarsu ta bambanta.
y-m-73-03.s.s1.hint.1: Ka saita kuɗin shiga na gidaje 5 da kanka, sannan ka yi la’akari da ƙimar da kake buƙata a wannan misali domin sanin ko jimlar ƙarshe ta labarin gaskiya ce ko ƙarya.
y-m-73-03.s.s1.o.a: Kuɗin shiga na gida da ke tsakiyar jerin lokacin da aka jera gidajen bisa girman kuɗin shigarsu
y-m-73-03.s.s1.r.a: Ko aƙalla rabinsu sun wuce wani ƙima yana da alaƙa kai tsaye da ƙimar gidan da ke tsakiyar jerin. Ka gano wata ƙima ta wakilci banda matsakaici.
y-m-73-03.s.s1.o.b: Kuɗin shiga na gidan da ya fi kowa kuɗin shiga
y-m-73-03.s.s1.r.b: Mafi girman ƙima tana nuna abin da ke ɗaga matsakaici, amma ba ta nuna yadda kuɗin shigar sauran gidaje ya bazu ba.
y-m-73-03.s.s1.o.c: Matsakaicin 500 da aka ƙididdige har zuwa wurare biyu bayan ɗigo
y-m-73-03.s.s1.r.c: Ko da an rubuta matsakaicin da ƙarin daidaito, ba za a iya bambance rarrabawa mabambanta masu matsakaici iri ɗaya ba.
y-m-73-03.s.s1.o.d: Wata ƙima da aka samu ta sake bincika yawan gidajen da ke zaune a wannan ƙauye
y-m-73-03.s.s1.r.d: An riga an bayar da cewa adadin gidaje 5 ne, kuma ko da an san wannan ƙima, matsakaici ba ya bayyana yadda rarrabawar take.
y-m-73-03.s.s1.explain: Idan aka jera gidaje 5 bisa girman kuɗin shiga, gida na 3 ne a tsakiya. “Aƙalla rabinsu suna samun fiye da 400” yana nufin kuɗin shiga na gidan tsakiya ya fi 400. Matsakaici na iya karkata sosai saboda gida ɗaya ko biyu masu kuɗin shiga babba, saboda haka bai isa a yanke wannan hukunci ba. (Tabbas, sanin kuɗin shiga na kowane gida ma zai isa, amma idan za a zaɓi abu guda ɗaya, shi ne ƙimar tsakiya.)
y-m-73-03.s.s2.prompt: Ƙirƙiri jerin kuɗin shiga daban-daban guda 2 na gidaje 5 waɗanda matsakaicinsu daidai yake da 500 amma jimlar ƙarshe ta labarin (“aƙalla rabinsu suna samun fiye da 400”) ƙarya ce. Shigar da kuɗin shiga daga mafi ƙanƙanta a jere a matsayin a ≤ b ≤ c ≤ d ≤ e. (Ana iya maimaita ƙima iri ɗaya.)
y-m-73-03.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko rubuta lambobi biyar waɗanda jimlarsu ta zama 2500, sannan ka duba wace ƙima ce a tsakiya idan aka jera su.
y-m-73-03.s.s2.hint.1: Gwada yadda jimlar sauran lambobi huɗu ke canzawa idan ka sa mafi girman lamba e ta yi yawa.
y-m-73-03.s.s2.var.a: Gida mai mafi ƙarancin kuɗin shiga (yen 10,000)
y-m-73-03.s.s2.var.e: Gida mai mafi girman kuɗin shiga (yen 10,000)
y-m-73-03.s.s2.ok.c1: An jera su daga mafi ƙanƙanta, kuma duk lambobi cikakku ne, aƙalla 100.
y-m-73-03.s.s2.fail.c1: Rubuta su a jere daga mafi ƙanƙanta (a ≤ b ≤ c ≤ d ≤ e), kuma dukkansu su zama lambobi cikakku aƙalla 100.
y-m-73-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Jimlar lambobi biyar dole ta zama 2500 domin matsakaici ya zama 500.
y-m-73-03.s.s2.ok.c3: Ƙasa da rabinsu ne suke samun fiye da 400.
y-m-73-03.s.s2.fail.c3: Idan gidan tsakiya (c) ya fi 400, to gidaje 3 ko fiye ne za su fi 400. Ka yi tunanin abin da ya kamata c ya kasance domin furucin labarin ya zama ƙarya.
y-m-73-03.s.s2.explain: Misali: (100, 200, 300, 400, 1500) jimlarsu 2500 ce kuma ƙimar tsakiya 300 ce, don haka gida 1 ne kawai ke samun fiye da 400. (400, 400, 400, 400, 900) yana da gidaje 4 masu “400 ko ƙasa da haka”. Tun da an ce “fiye da”, ba a ƙirga gidan da ke da 400 a matsayin mai samun fiye da wannan adadi ba. Ko da matsakaicin iri ɗaya ne, idan gida ɗaya yana da ƙima babba sosai, sauran na iya zama ƙanana.
y-m-73-03.s.s2.because.prompt: Ta amfani da misalan da ka ƙirƙira, rubuta ko bayanin cewa matsakaici 500 ne kaɗai ya isa a yanke hukunci kan jimlar ƙarshe ta labarin, sannan ka ba da dalilinka.
y-m-73-03.s.s2.because.hint.0: A misalin da ka ƙirƙira, rubuta matsakaici, kuɗin shiga na gidan tsakiya, da na gidan da ya fi kowa, kowannensu a layi ɗaya.
y-m-73-03.s.s2.because.hint.1: Ka kuma yi tunanin jerin gidaje 5 guda ɗaya masu matsakaici iri ɗaya inda furucin labarin yake gaskiya, sannan ka kwatanta misalan biyu.
y-m-73-03.s.s2.because.placeholder: Misali: Matsakaici kaɗai bai isa ba ... saboda ...
y-m-73-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: A cikin bayaninka, ka rubuta cewa a misalin da ka ƙirƙira matsakaicin 500 ne amma furucin labarin ƙarya ne?
y-m-73-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ka ambaci abin da yake zama dalili, kamar “gidan tsakiya” ko “ƙima mai girma sosai”?
y-m-73-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.2: Ka kuma yi tunanin cewa furucin labarin na iya zama gaskiya (idan ƙimar tsakiya ta fi 400)?
y-m-73-03.s.s2.because.model.0: Ko da matsakaici 500 ne, idan gidan guda ɗaya yana da kuɗin shiga babba sosai, kamar 1500, sauran na iya zama ƙanana. A misalin sama matsakaici 500 ne amma gidan tsakiya yana da 300. Saboda haka matsakaici kaɗai ba ya nuna ko rabin gidajen suna samun fiye da 400.
y-m-73-03.s.s2.because.model.1: Idan kuɗin shiga na wasu gidaje yana da yawa sosai, matsakaici zai hau. Matsakaicin 500 ne, amma gidaje 4 daga cikin 5 za su iya samun 400 ko ƙasa da haka. Hukunci bisa matsakaici kaɗai bai isa ba; dole ne a duba ƙimar tsakiya ma.
y-m-73-03.s.s2.because.modelNote.1: Bai ambaci yanayin da furucin yake gaskiya ba, amma ya cika muhimmin batu.

y-m-73-02.thinking.0: Jinkirta hukunci idan bayanin bai isa ba.
y-m-73-02.prereq.3: Lakabin H3 alamar wahalar wannan aikin samarwa ne kawai, ba matakin ajin karatu ba. Zato: dalibi ya fara lissafin tattalin arziki a matakin sakandare.
y-m-73-02.title: Wurin da matsakaicin kudin kaya ya fi karanci shi ne wurin da riba ta fi girma?
y-m-73-02.topic: Matsakaicin kudi da yawan samarwa mafi riba
y-m-73-02.goal: Duba cewa mafi karancin matsakaicin kudin kaya da yawan samarwa mafi riba na iya bambanta; gyara hukuncinka da zarar bayanin farashi ya zo.
y-m-73-02.material:
Bitar sabulun hannu tana samar da kaya q (cikakkiyar lamba) a wata kuma ta sayar da su duka. Jimillar kudin wata ita ce C(q) = 50 + 10q + q² (ma'auni: 천 원). 50 kudin tsayayye ne, ana biya kowane wata ko da ba a samar da kaya ko daya ba. Riba = farashin sayarwa × q − C(q). Matsakaicin kudin kaya daya = C(q) ÷ q. (Ana karanta q² a matsayin 'q a murabba'i'.)

Yawan samarwa q (kaya) | Jimillar kudi (천 원) | Matsakaicin kudi ga kaya (천 원)
1 | 61 | 61.00
3 | 89 | 29.67
5 | 125 | 25.00
7 | 169 | 24.14
8 | 194 | 24.25
10 | 250 | 25.00
15 | 425 | 28.33
20 | 650 | 32.50

(Karanta jadawalin bisa tsari q, jimillar kudi, matsakaicin kudi. Cikin cikakkun dabi'un q, mafi karancin matsakaicin kudi yana q=7.)
y-m-73-02.thinking.2: Kirkiri dabi'u da dama da suka cika sharadi
y-m-73-02.prereq.0: Saka lambobi cikin furuci mai murabba'i
y-m-73-02.prereq.2: Bambance darajar matsakaici ta kaya daya da jimillar
y-m-73-02.s.s1.prompt: Za a bayyana farashi kashi-kashi. A kowane mataki zabi hukuncin da ya fi dacewa yanzu.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.hint.0: A kowane mataki fara rubuta lambobin da aka sani da wadanda ba a sani ba tukuna.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.hint.1: Zabi lambobi biyu ko uku ka kwatanta don duba ko hukuncinka ya dace da lambobin riba da aka bayyana.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.0.info: Jadawalin sama kadai ka sani. Ba ka san farashin sayar da kaya daya ba tukuna.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.0.ask: Za mu iya cewa riba ta fi idan an samar da kaya 7, inda matsakaicin kudi ya fi karanci?
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.0.after: Riba tana dogara da farashin sayarwa; jadawalin kudi kadai ba zai nuna yawan samarwar da ke da babbar riba ba. A yanzu jinkirta hukunci shi ne amsar da ta fi samun goyon baya.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.0.o.a: I. A kaya 7 inda kudin kaya ya fi karanci, riba ma ita ce mafi girma.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ka danganta karancin kudi kai tsaye da babbar riba. Riba ta danganta da farashin sayarwa ma, don haka ba za a tabbatar da ita daga jadawalin kudi kadai ba.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Ba tare da sanin farashin sayarwa ba, ba za a iya ƙididdige riba ba, saboda haka lokaci bai yi ba a yanke hukunci yanzu.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ba ka manta cewa riba ita ce bambanci tsakanin kuɗin shiga da kuɗin kashewa ba. Ka nuna irin ƙarin bayanin da ake buƙatar sani.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Idan ka ƙera abubuwa ƙasa da 7 kaɗan, kuɗin kowane abu zai ragu, don haka ribar za ta ƙaru.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.0.r.c: A cikin teburin, adadin ƙera da ya yi ƙasa (abubuwa 5, abubuwa 3) a zahiri yana da kuɗin kowane abu mafi girma. Kana buƙatar sake duba yadda za a karanta teburin.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.1.info: Yanzu an san cewa farashin sayar da kowane abu shi ne 40 (千 yen). Idan aka ƙididdige riba = 40q − C(q), ribar ita ce 111 idan q=7, 150 idan q=10, 175 idan q=15, 150 idan q=20, kuma 75 idan q=25. (ƙimar asali: 40 천 원)
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.1.ask: Yanzu yaya za ka yanke hukunci? (A cikin adadin da aka nuna a teburin)
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.1.after: Idan farashin sayarwa ya fi matsakaicin kuɗi 24.14 sosai, to idan an ƙera fiye da abubuwa 7, kuɗin shiga da aka ƙara ya fi kuɗin da aka ƙara, don haka riba za ta ƙara ƙaruwa. Riba ta fi yawa idan an ƙera abubuwa 15, wato 175 (idan ana ƙirga cikakkun lambobi), sannan ta ragu.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Riba ta fi yawa idan aka ƙera abubuwa 7, inda matsakaicin kuɗi ya fi ƙasa.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Adadin da ya fi ribar 111 na abubuwa 7 ya bayyana a abubuwa 10 (150) da abubuwa 15 (175). Ka kwatanta da lambobin da ka bincika yanzu.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Yayin da ake ƙara yawan abubuwan da aka ƙera, riba tana ci gaba da ƙaruwa.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Idan aka duba abubuwa 20 (150) da abubuwa 25 (75), daga wani wuri riba tana raguwa. Wannan hukunci bai karanta teburin har ƙarshe ba.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Ƙera fiye da abubuwa 7 yana ba da riba mafi yawa, kuma abubuwa 15 ne suka fi yawa.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ka kwatanta lambobin riba kai tsaye, kuma ka fahimci cewa mafi ƙarancin matsakaicin kuɗi da mafi girman riba na iya kasancewa a adadi daban-daban.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.2.info: Gasar ta ƙara tsananta kuma farashin kowane abu ya sauka zuwa 24 (千 yen). Har yanzu ana biyan tsayayyen kuɗi 50 a wannan watan ko da an dakatar da ƙera. Riba = 24q − C(q): −50 idan q=0, −5 idan q=5, −2 idan q=6, −1 idan q=7, −2 idan q=8, kuma −10 idan q=10. (ƙimar asali: 24 천 원)
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.2.ask: A wannan farashin, wane hukunci ne ya fi dacewa da shirin ƙerawa na wannan watan?
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.2.after: A farashin 24, duk yawan ƙera yana haifar da asara. Amma ana biyan tsayayyen kuɗi 50 ko ta yaya, saboda haka −1 idan an ƙera abubuwa 7 ya fi −50 idan an ƙera abubuwa 0. (Da a ce za a iya kauce wa tsayayyen kuɗin, hukuncin zai bambanta, amma a wannan matsalar mun ɗauka ba za a iya kauce masa ba.)
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Asara ce, amma asarar ta fi ƙanƙanta idan an ƙera abubuwa 7, saboda haka ya fi kyau a ƙera su.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ka saka a kwatancen sharadin cewa ana biyan tsayayyen kuɗin ko da an ƙera wani abu ko ba a ƙera ba. Wannan ya bambanta da hukunci da ya bar tsayayyen kuɗin waje.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Duk yawan ƙera yana haifar da asara, saboda haka ya fi kyau kada a ƙera ko abu ɗaya.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Wannan hukunci ya bar −50 na rashin ƙera komai. Idan aka yi la’akari da sharadin cewa za a biya tsayayyen kuɗin ko ta yaya, ka kuma kwatanta ribar idan an ƙera abubuwa 0.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Idan aka ƙera abubuwa 7, inda matsakaicin kuɗi ya fi ƙanƙanta, za a samu riba a wannan watan.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ka rasa cewa matsakaicin kuɗi 24.14 ya fi farashin sayarwa 24. Ko da mafi ƙarancin matsakaicin kuɗi ya fi farashin.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.reflect: Ka sake duba hukuncinka guda uku. Yaushe ne yawan ƙerar da ke da mafi ƙarancin matsakaicin kuɗi ya yi daidai da yawan ƙerar da ke da mafi girman riba? Da farashin sayarwa ya canza, ta yaya yawan ƙerar da ke da mafi girman riba ya canza?
y-m-73-02.s.s2.prompt: Idan farashin sayarwa ya zama 40 (千 yen), shigar da yawan ƙera q daban-daban guda 3 waɗanda ribarsu ta fi ta ƙera abubuwa 7, inda matsakaicin kuɗi ya fi ƙanƙanta. (q cikakkiyar lamba ce daga 1 zuwa 30; ƙimar asali 40 천 원.)
y-m-73-02.s.s2.hint.0: Zaɓi wasu ƙimomin q kamar 7, 10, 20, 25, ƙididdige ribarsu, kwatanta da 111, sannan ka tsara su a tebur.
y-m-73-02.s.s2.hint.1: Domin gano inda ribar ta fara wuce 111 da kuma inda ta sake sauka ƙasa, sauya q da ɗaya-ɗaya ka gwada iyakokin.
y-m-73-02.s.s2.fail.c1: q dole ne ya zama cikakkiyar lamba daga 1 zuwa 30.
y-m-73-02.s.s2.ok.c2: Ribar ta fi 111 na ƙera abubuwa 7.
y-m-73-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Ribar ba ta fi 111 ba. Ka ƙididdige 40q − C(q), sannan ka kwatanta da 111 na abubuwa 7.
y-m-73-02.s.s2.explain: Ribar ita ce −q² + 30q − 50, saboda haka ta fi 111 idan q=8 zuwa 22. Misali, q=8 yana ba da 126, 10 yana ba da 150, 15 yana ba da 175, kuma 22 yana ba da 126. q=23 yana ba da 111, wanda ya yi daidai, yayin da 25 ke ba da 75, ƙasa da ribar abubuwa 7. Riba mafi girma ita ce 175 idan an ƙera abubuwa 15.
y-m-73-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Ta amfani da lambobi, ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa idan farashin sayarwa ya zama 40, abubuwa 7 da ke da mafi ƙarancin matsakaicin kuɗi ba su ne yawan ƙerar da ke da mafi girman riba ba.
y-m-73-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: Sanya ƙerar abubuwa 7 da abubuwa 10 gefe da gefe a teburin riba, sannan ka duba inda bambancin ribarsu ya fito.
y-m-73-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Ka ƙididdige dabam kuɗin da aka ƙara da kuɗin shiga da aka ƙara idan an tashi daga ƙera abubuwa 7 zuwa 8, sannan ka kwatanta su.
y-m-73-02.s.s2.because.placeholder: Misali: Idan aka ƙera ƙarin abu guda bayan abubuwa 7 ...
y-m-73-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: A cikin bayaninka, ka rubuta cewa “matsakaicin kuɗin kowane abu” da “riba” abubuwa ne mabambanta?
y-m-73-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ka bincika lambobin da ka yi amfani da su a teburin riba?
y-m-73-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.2: Ka yi la’akari da yiwuwar hukuncin ya canza idan farashin sayarwa ya canza?
y-m-73-02.s.s2.because.model.0: Matsakaicin kuɗi kuɗin kowane abu ne kawai. Idan farashin sayarwa ya zama 40, ƙarin kuɗin abu na 8 bayan guda 7 (kimanin 25) ya yi ƙasa da 40, saboda haka idan aka ƙara ƙera, riba tana ƙaruwa. A zahiri, abubuwa 7 suna ba da 111, yayin da abubuwa 15 suke ba da 175.
y-m-73-02.s.s2.because.model.1: Farashin shi ne 40, wanda ya bambanta ƙwarai da matsakaicin kuɗi 24.14. Muddin ƙarin kuɗin da ke zuwa daga ƙara yawan abubuwa ya yi ƙasa da farashin 40, ƙera ƙarin abubuwa yana ƙara riba. Abubuwa 10 suna ba da 150, fiye da 111 na abubuwa 7.

y-m-73-01.title: Idan ya karu 50% sannan ya ragu 50%
y-m-73-01.topic: Aiwatar da sauyin kaso a jere
y-m-73-01.goal: Kaso yana dogara da darajar nan da nan kafin shi. Yi amfani da wannan wajen gano kuskuren mafita da ta tara kaso kawai, sannan kirkiri haduwar karuwa da raguwa da ke komawa darajar farko.
y-m-73-01.material: Yawan masu ziyartar shagon intanet ya karu 50% daga farkon Janairu, sannan ya ragu 50% daga darajar Janairu a Fabrairu. Kowanne kaso yana dogara da adadin masu ziyara na watan da ya gabata. A dauki farko 100 kuma a yarda da decimal. Ga mafitar dalibi.
y-m-73-01.thinking.0: Nemo layin mafitar da ya saba wa juna
y-m-73-01.thinking.1: Sanin cewa tushe idan ya sauya, kaso daya yana bada adadi dabam
y-m-73-01.thinking.2: Kirkiri haduwa da dama da ta cika sharadi
y-m-73-01.prereq.0: Lissafin karin da rage kaso ta ninkawa (matakin sakandare)
y-m-73-01.prereq.1: Warwarewa ta hanyar gwajin lissafin cikakkiyar lamba
y-m-73-01.prereq.2: Lakabin H3 alamar wahalar wannan aikin samarwa ne kawai, ba matakin ajin karatu ba. Zato: dalibi ya fara lissafin tattalin arziki a matakin sakandare.
y-m-73-01.s.s1.prompt: Zabi layi daya mara daidai a mafitar.
y-m-73-01.s.s1.hint.0: Ga kowane layi rubuta adadin masu ziyara da yake nufi, sannan nemo layuka biyu masu lambobi dabam ga wata daya.
y-m-73-01.s.s1.hint.1: A layuka 2 da 3 duba tushen da +50% da -50% ke nufin kashi 50% nasa.
y-m-73-01.s.s1.line.0: Dauki adadin farko na masu ziyara 100.
y-m-73-01.s.s1.line.1: Janairu: masu ziyara 100 sun karu 50% sun zama 150.
y-m-73-01.s.s1.line.2: Fabrairu: masu ziyara 150 sun ragu 50% sun zama 75.
y-m-73-01.s.s1.line.3: Tun da +50% da −50% idan aka tara su sun zama 0%, yawan masu ziyara a Fabrairu shi ne 100, daidai da na farko.
y-m-73-01.s.s1.line.4: Saboda haka yawan masu ziyara bai canza cikin watanni biyun ba.
y-m-73-01.s.s1.explain: Layi na 3 ya ce masu ziyara 75 a Fabrairu, amma layi na 4 ya ce 100; ba su dace ba. +50% da -50% a layi na 4 suna da tushen dabam (na farko 100 ne, na biyu 150). Ana tara ko rage kaso idan tushen daya ne kawai. Layi na 4 kuskure ne, kuma layi na 5 da aka gina a kansa ma kuskure ne.
y-m-73-01.s.s2.prompt: Kirkiri haduwa da ke komawa darajar farko daidai. Shigar da nau'i-nau'i 2 daban (p,q): daraja ta karu p% a watan farko sannan ta ragu q% daga darajar lokacin a wata na gaba, don haka bayan watanni biyu ta koma daidai. p cikakkiyar lamba ce daga 1 zuwa 500, q daga 1 zuwa 99.
y-m-73-01.s.s2.hint.0: Zabi p, nemo darajar bayan watan farko, sannan gwada kaso nawa za a rage don komawa 100.
y-m-73-01.s.s2.hint.1: Gwada ko p da q za su iya zama daya; idan ba haka ba, kwatanta ko q ya fi ko ya kasa p.
y-m-73-01.s.s2.fail.c1: p cikakkiyar lamba ce daga 1 zuwa 500, q kuma cikakkiyar lamba daga 1 zuwa 99.
y-m-73-01.s.s2.ok.c2: Darajar bayan watanni biyu daidai take da ta farko.
y-m-73-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Darajar bayan watanni biyu ta bambanta. Nemo darajar bayan watan farko, sannan duba darajar bayan rage q% daga gare ta.
y-m-73-01.s.s2.explain: Misali: idan ya karu 25%, darajar 100 ta zama 125; 20% na 125 shi ne 25, saboda haka rage 20% ya mayar da ita 100. Idan ya karu 100%, ya zama 200 kuma rage 50% ya bada 100; idan ya karu 150%, ya zama 250 kuma rage 60% ya bada 100. (300, 75) da (400, 80) ma suna aiki. Domin darajar bayan karuwa ta fi girma, kaso da ake ragewa don komawa ya fi kason karuwa karanci.
y-m-73-01.s.s2.because.prompt: Da lamba daya bayyana dalilin da ya sa p da q ba su zama daya ba a haduwarka.
y-m-73-01.s.s2.because.hint.0: Zabi daya daga haduwarka, ka fara rubuta darajar bayan watan farko.
y-m-73-01.s.s2.because.hint.1: Nemo q% na darajar nan, ka kwatanta da q% na darajar farko.
y-m-73-01.s.s2.because.placeholder: Misali: tushen kason da aka cire daga 125 shi ne ...

y-m-73-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ka bayyana tushen kason raguwa a fili?
y-m-73-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.2: Ka lissafa lambobin da kanka ka tabbatar da su?
y-m-73-01.s.s2.because.model.0: Bayan karuwa darajar ta wuce 100, don haka tushen kason raguwa ya sauya. Rage 25% na 125 da aka samu daga karuwar 25% yana bada 93.75, ba ya komawa; dole a rage 20%, wato 25, don samun 100.
y-m-73-01.s.s2.because.model.1: A watan farko tushen kaso 100 ne, a na biyu kuma tushen kaso 150 ne. Ko da kason 50% iri daya ne, adadin da aka cire daga 150 ya fi girma, ya kai 75; saboda haka kason da ake ragewa don komawa na iya karanci, kamar yadda (150%, 60%) ya nuna.
y-m-73-01.s.s2.because.modelNote.1: Wani bayani da aka sauya misalansa
y-m-73-01.s.s2.because.model.2: Idan p=25 da q=20, rage 125 da 20% yana cire 25 ya komawa 100. 25% na 125 shi ne 31.25, saboda haka q=25 zai rage fiye da kima.
